title: Ottomans crush a crusading army at Varna
summary: Sultan Murad II defeated a Hungarian and Polish crusader army near the Black Sea port of Varna. King Wladyslaw III of Poland and Hungary was killed in the battle.
reason: The crusade aimed to drive the Ottomans out of the Balkans and relieve Constantinople, breaking a recent peace treaty.
significance: It ended the last major European attempt to save Byzantium before the fall of Constantinople.
